papers.title: Local Feature Selection without Label or Feature Leakage for Interpretable Machine Learning Predictions
papers.findings: No-leakage definitions and Bayes equivalences require positive-support events and selector-independent natural data law; SUWR proof only observes already selected features and never removes them. Global normalization can reintroduce omitted-value dependence. Uniqueness is a conjecture, not TheoremC.1.

papers.title: RORA: Robust Free-Text Rationale Evaluation
papers.findings: Conditional V-information is predictive-family-relative. Practical RORA uses small-model attribution, counterfactual infilling and IRM regularization to approximate ignoring leaky rationale information; no exact leakage detection, semantic correctness or complete-model Q-RMEA theorem follows.
